ui.posture.c.webhook_no_secret: A webhook has no secret: its receiver cannot tell a real delivery from a forged one.
ui.posture.c.webhook_plain_http: A webhook sends over plain HTTP.
ui.posture.c.webhook_tls_off: A webhook does not check the certificate of its receiver.
ui.posture.c.actions_token_write: The token of the workflows can write by default; set it to read.
ui.posture.c.actions_all_allowed: Any action of anyone is allowed to run.
ui.posture.c.actions_sha_not_required: Actions need not be pinned to a commit.
ui.posture.c.actions_fork_approval: Runs from forks need approval only for brand new GitHub accounts.
ui.posture.c.scan_no_push_protection: Push protection of secrets is off.
ui.posture.c.repo_no_update_tool: No tool keeps the dependencies up to date (Dependabot or Renovate).
ui.posture.c.branch_unprotected: The default branch has no protection.
ui.posture.c.branch_no_review: No review is required to change the default branch.
ui.posture.c.branch_bypass: Someone can skip the protection or the review.
ui.posture.c.branch_release_unprotected: A release branch has no protection.
ui.posture.c.branch_merged_unreviewed: A change was merged without an approval.
ui.posture.c.deploy_write: A deploy key can write to the repository.
ui.posture.c.deploy_old: A deploy key is old; rotate it.
ui.posture.c.stored_old: A secret of Actions has not been changed for a long time.
ui.posture.c.org_no_two_factor: The organization does not require two-factor sign-in.
ui.posture.c.org_default_write: Members can write to every repository by default.
ui.posture.c.org_public_creation: Any member can create public repositories.
ui.posture.c.org_app_broad: An app can write sensitive things in all repositories.
ui.posture.c.org_settings_changed: A setting that protects the organization was changed recently.
ui.posture.c.runner_not_hardened: A workflow ran without a hardening step.
ui.posture.c.runner_coverage_lost: A workflow that had a hardening step no longer runs it.
ui.posture.c.release_asset_replaced: A file of a published release was replaced.
ui.posture.c.release_asset_removed: A file of a published release was removed.
ui.posture.c.release_tag_moved: The tag of a published release points to another commit.
ui.posture.c.release_outside_window: A release was published outside the agreed hours.
ui.cfg_b_posture: Posture of repositories and organization (read only)
cfg.h.posture.enabled: Reads settings of your repositories and organization (GET only) and says what is weak. It uses GitHub allowance. Off by default.
cfg.h.posture.alerts: Each finding appears in the Alerts tab, where it can be silenced.
cfg.h.posture.profile: basic: the checks that matter to everyone. strict: all of them.
cfg.h.posture.types: pattern=standard|library|internal|sandbox, for example demo-*=sandbox. Each kind has its own baseline.
cfg.h.posture.skip: Identifiers such as scan.no_code, one per entry.
cfg.h.posture.repos_per_cycle: Spreads the use of the allowance over the cycles.
cfg.h.posture.refresh_hours: Each repository is read at most once in this time.
cfg.h.posture.org_checks: Settings, hooks, secrets by name and apps of the organization (needs organization read rights).
cfg.h.posture.audit_log: Raises changes of protective settings of the last 7 days (GitHub Enterprise only).
cfg.h.posture.review_sample: How many merged pull requests are checked for an approval (0 = none).
cfg.h.posture.runner_runs: How many recent runs have their steps read (0 = off).
cfg.h.posture.releases: Notices replaced or removed files and moved tags since the first read.
cfg.h.posture.release_window: Days and hours in UTC, as 1-5 07-19 (1 = Monday); empty = any time.
cfg.h.posture.release_branches: Patterns of branches that must be protected like the default one.
cfg.h.posture.deploy_max_days: Days after which a deploy key is old.
cfg.h.posture.stored_max_days: Days without change after which a secret of Actions is old. Only names and dates are read.
ui.posture.title: Posture
ui.posture.summary: Repositories read: {repos}. Things that could not be checked: {unchecked}.
ui.posture.none: No finding in what was read.
cli.posture.help: Posture of repositories and organization, read only: status, matrix, check --repo-name NAME.
cli.posture.help_repo: The repository to read now (posture check).
